description: Scope identity for every ingested observation. scope_id is the ONLY key permitted for cross-source and cross-region comparison. Two items sharing an activity_type but not a scope_id are never pooled.
rule: Same scope_id + same normalized unit + compatible evidence_purpose is required before any pooling, median or variance is computed.

partition_framing:framing_only:m2:v1.note: Framing skeleton only. Stud spacing is a design parameter recorded on the observation, not part of the scope boundary.

ceiling_grid:accessible_flat:m2:v1.note: Accessible (上人型) flat grid. Access class is held in the scope because it changes hanger duty.

includes: stepped / dropped level formwork of the grid
ceiling_grid:accessible_stepped:m2:v1.note: Stepped (跌级) form. The engine has a separate feature_ceiling activity, so flat-grid equivalence is not assumed.

gypsum_ceiling:single_layer_with_taping:.note: Single layer, board thickness recorded on the observation. Taping IS included.

gypsum_ceiling:single_layer_no_taping:m2.note: Taping is priced as a separate sub-item. NOT comparable with single_layer_with_taping.

gypsum_ceiling:double_layer:m2:v1.note: Layer count is a scope condition, not an increment.

includes: one additional board layer on an existing layer
gypsum_ceiling:incremental_layer:m2:v1.note: Delta item, not a complete activity.

excludes: full skim coat / 满刮腻子
painting:coats_only_no_prep:m2:v1.note: Matches the engine painting declaration 'excludes substrate preparation'. Putty is a separate sub-item in this quota.

painting:incremental_coat:m2:v1.note: Delta item, not a complete activity.

includes: two full skim coats / 满刮腻子二遍
painting_plus_prep:wall_composite:m2:v1.note: Composite of wall_prep + painting. Assigning the whole value to painting would double-count preparation already carried by wall_prep.

painting_plus_prep:ceiling_composite:m2:.note: Same composite boundary as the wall version, applied to a soffit.

carpet:tile_no_tackless_no_underlay:m2:v.note: Dry-laid carpet tile. Excludes fixing and underlay.

carpet:fixed_with_tackless:m2:v1.note: Fully fixed broadloom. Includes fixing components absent from the tile scope.

carpet:tile_single_layer:m2:v1.note: Modular tile with seaming tape and adhesive. Fixing method differs from the Shanghai dry-laid tile scope.

raised_floor:timber_with_supports:m2:v1.note: Timber core panel. Calcium-sulphate and steel panels are not interchangeable.

containment:tray_no_supports:m:v1.note: Support steel is NOT in the material schedule and is priced elsewhere, so the item understates installed length productivity.

lighting:surface_mounted_small:each:v1.note: Size class is a condition (shade circumference limit), recorded on the observation.

hvac_duct:fabricate_and_install:m2:v1.note: Fabrication and installation are merged, and part of the fabrication is off-site. Not comparable with an install-only site scope.

gypsum_boarding:nail_spot_prime:m2:v1.note: No engine activity type carries this work separately. Retained as reference only.
